definitions.explanation: A person who draws likenesses or caricatures of people, often quickly at tourist spots, events, or street corners.

examples.english: A portrait artist was drawing pictures in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。

⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{似顔絵|にがおえ}{師|し}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}いて→描く：28436_kaku⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: We had a professional portrait artist draw a picture of the whole family.
